glosses: The central core of a plant's root and stem system, especially including the vascular tissue and developed from the plerome.

examples.text: The stele may have—in different structures—one to many protoxylem (primitive wood) groups, and is accordingly described as monarch...diarch...triarch...tetrarch...polyarch.
